name: Buran OK-1K
about: Buran OK-1K (1988-100A), a crewed vehicle (Buran1), launched 1988 Nov 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 Nov 15), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KB) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
